messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync 10am PT event next Thursday. Finalizing reg page, Zoom settings, and post-event lead path. Who can pick up each item?
Omar Reyes: Ill build the reg page. Plan: simple email-first form, optional company field, consent checkbox, hidden utm fields. Need final hero image and the short blurb.
Priya Singh: Uploading final copy in 20. Add GDPR language and a small "Request transcript" checkbox under preferences.
Sam Cho: Zoom ops: enabling cloud recording w/ separate audio tracks, auto-record, co-hosts set, and SRT captions export. Also enabling participant name display for clip attribution.
Jenna Liu: Ill handle live captions and SRT QA. Otter.ai integration okay? Ill run a caption test during the runthrough.
Tom Ruiz: Lead routing: HubSpot. Map utm_source -> original_source, utm_medium -> channel, utm_campaign -> campaign. Trigger: form submit. Actions: create contact, set lifecycle_stage=lead, add to "Event-ScaleRun-Registrants" list, send immediate confirmation. After attendance, set lifecycle_stage=MQL and add "attended" tag.
Omar Reyes: One question: two-step reg (email verify) vs single-step? For PLG crowd I vote single-step.
Maya Patel: Single-step. Keep friction down. Add calendar invite download on confirmation page and in email.
Sam Cho: Zoom config snippet I'll apply:
```
- Cloud recording: ON (active speaker + shared screen)
- Audio: separate tracks
- Alternative hosts: sam.cho@redwood.com, jenna.liu@redwood.com
- Auto-assign co-host on join
- Enable SRT export for captions
```
Sam Cho: Contingency: local backup recording on host laptop + RTMP fallback if cloud fails. I'll bring spare laptop to runthrough.
Jenna Liu: Post-event artifacts: SRT and transcript -> Google Drive folder "ScaleRun_Event_Assets". I'll tag clip owners (marketing-clip-ops). Aim to deliver raw transcript + clips within 8 hours.
Tom Ruiz: Post-event sequences: attendees -> send replay + transcript at +24h, non-attendees -> drip with highlights + CTA to watch clips at +48h. Also create a nurturing list for no-shows.
Priya Singh: Draft confirmation email: "Thanks for registering for ScaleRun: Production Inference. We'll email the live link 24h before and send recording + transcript within 24h after the event. Add to calendar attached." Thoughts?
Maya Patel: Good. Make the CTA to request specific clips more visible in the confirmation. Also add a short survey link for topic preferences.
Omar Reyes: Wiring reg page to HubSpot endpoint now, will include hidden utm fields and test submission. Posting test results here.
calendar-bot: Event created: "ScaleRun: Production Inference at Scale" 10:00am PT 1 Zoom link added.
Maya Patel: Action list: Omar = reg page + test, Priya = final copy + confirmation email, Sam = Zoom config + runthrough, Jenna = captions + SRT handoff, Tom = HubSpot workflow + post-event sequences. Stand-up tomorrow 11am PT to confirm. :thumbsup:
Omar Reyes: Test submitted. HubSpot contact created and utm fields captured. Will upload screenshot to the thread. :mag:
